text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wow, I didn't expect you to actually get one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why're you giving it to me? I told you I don't want it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Look, I'm not gonna put it on my bag. If you're really fine with that, I'll take it.
